name: com.empress.uitkvirtuastick
description: A lightweight virtual joystick designed natively for Unity's UI Toolkit, offering plug-and-play touch controls with full Input System compatibility. Ideal for mobile games, editor tools, or any UITK-based project requiring precise input.

samples.description: Explore VirtuaStick's core functionality with full runtime customization. Adjust stick radius, axis modes, dynamic positioning, and visual feedback—all in real time.
Customize VirtuaStick's look using Unity Style Sheets (USS). Switch themes live and explore how USS affects visuals like backgrounds, borders, and handle styling.
Dual-stick demo for mobile-style gameplay. Connect VirtuaStick to character and camera controllers using Unity’s Input System, with UI toggles for runtime behavior.
Discover four joystick variants tailored for different genres: D-Pad, Puzzle, Platformer, and Racing. Each is a subclass of VirtuaStick, ready for extension and reuse.
